TABLE.NAME: local_omeroembed_annotations
TABLE.COMMENT: Student-drawn annotations on an embedded OMERO slide - private to the student who created them (see classes/privacy/provider.php)

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the embed belongs to - matches the identity proxy.php already checks

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student this annotation belongs to

FIELD.NAME: embedid
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-placement token minted by author.js's generateEmbed(), not derived from the OMERO image id - the same image can be embedded in multiple places with independent annotations

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Annotation shape - only 'point' is supported so far

FIELD.NAME: geometry
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON, in real OMERO image-pixel coordinates - e.g. point: {x,y}

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional short student-entered note shown when the annotation is clicked
